results.title: Meta begins US rollout of Muse voice chats and animated avatars · Digg
results.description: Meta began rolling out voice conversations and expressive avatars in the Muse app in the US on Nov. 5, 2026. Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer, wrote that users could phone and video chat with their Muse agent.

results.title: Give Your Muse A Voice - Toksick Magazine
results.description: Meta says it previewed real-time conversations with Muse at Connect 2026. The November announcement describes the next step: bringing voice and expressive avatars into the Muse app, rather than introducing a separate product.

results.title: Give Your Muse A Voice - Cornford and Cross
results.description: The current announcement moves that preview into the Muse app, with access on mobile, web and Mac. It does not specify whether every user in the US will receive the feature at once or whether access will expand in stages.
